requirements.checkable: Each entry purchase mints one transferable ERC-721 ticket and charges a fixed price in USDC per entry.
requirements.quote: Defines one autonomous NFT raffle using fixed-price USDC entries and one transferable ERC-721 ticket per purchase.

requirements.checkable: Minted ticket IDs start at 1 and increment sequentially by 1 with each ticket purchase.
requirements.quote: Ticket IDs are sequential.

requirements.checkable: Each minted ticket records an inclusive uint128 entry range (firstEntry, lastEntry).
requirements.quote: Each ticket stores one inclusive uint128 entry range and remains a transferable bearer claim until its owner atomically burns it for redemption or refund.

requirements.checkable: Tickets remain transferable ERC-721 bearer tokens until burned by their current owner during redeemWinningTicket or refundTickets.
requirements.quote: Each ticket stores one inclusive uint128 entry range and remains a transferable bearer claim until its owner atomically burns it for redemption or refund.

requirements.checkable: External trust assumption that quoteToken is canonical 6-decimal USDC with standard non-rebasing fee-free transfers; code uses fixed 6-decimal pricing and exact transfer amounts without fee-on-transfer balance-delta accounting.
requirements.quote: The immutable quote token is trusted canonical six-decimal USDC with standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfers.

requirements.checkable: External trust assumption that prizeToken is an honest, standards-compliant ERC-721 contract.
requirements.quote: Supported prizes are honest, standards-compliant ERC-721s.

requirements.checkable: Upon clone initialization and prior to the factory escrowing the prize NFT, status() is Status.AwaitingPrize.
requirements.quote: The clone is initialized and waiting for the factory to escrow the configured prize.

requirements.checkable: Once the configured prize NFT is escrowed into the raffle, status() transitions to Status.Active where entry purchases and post-sale draw requests are permitted.
requirements.quote: The prize is escrowed and entry sales or post-sale draw initiation are available.

requirements.checkable: When a Chainlink VRF draw request is accepted, status() transitions to Status.Drawing while the callback window is open.
requirements.quote: A Chainlink VRF request was accepted and its callback window is open.

requirements.checkable: When the VRF callback resolves a raffle whose totalEntries meets or exceeds reserveEntries, status() becomes Status.NftWon and the winning ticket owner can redeem the prize NFT.
requirements.quote: The reserve was met and the winning ticket may redeem the prize NFT.

requirements.checkable: When the VRF callback resolves a raffle whose totalEntries is strictly less than reserveEntries, status() becomes Status.CashWon and the winning ticket owner can redeem the cash allocation.
requirements.quote: The reserve was missed and the winning ticket may redeem its cash allocation.

requirements.checkable: When status() is Status.Refunding, ticket owners can claim full ticket refunds and the sponsor can recover the escrowed prize NFT.
requirements.quote: Full ticket refunds are enabled and the sponsor may recover the prize NFT.

requirements.checkable: reserveEntries acts as an inclusive threshold: totalEntries >= reserveEntries selects Status.NftWon upon VRF resolution.
requirements.quote: @param reserveEntries Global raw entry-count threshold selecting the NFT outcome when met or exceeded.

requirements.checkable: endTime is an exclusive upper bound on entry sales: buyEntries is only allowed when block.timestamp < endTime.
requirements.quote: @param endTime Unix timestamp, in seconds, at which entry sales end exclusively.

requirements.checkable: Depositing the configured prize from the factory into the raffle transitions status to Active and emits PrizeDeposited(prizeToken, prizeTokenId, sponsor).
requirements.quote: Emitted when the factory deposits the configured prize and activates the raffle.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries charges grossAmount == entryCount * ENTRY_PRICE in quoteToken and emits TicketPurchased(buyer, recipient, ticketId, firstEntry, lastEntry, entryCount, grossAmount).
requirements.quote: @param grossAmount Raw six-decimal quote-token units paid, equal to `entryCount * ENTRY_PRICE`.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw emits DrawRequested(requestId, requester, fee, excessReturned, drawRequestedAt, callbackDeadline) when the VRF request is paid for and recorded.
requirements.quote: Emitted when the raffle pays for and records its one Chainlink VRF request.

requirements.checkable: The VRF callback is only accepted before the exclusive callbackDeadline timestamp (block.timestamp < callbackDeadline).
requirements.quote: @param callbackDeadline Exclusive Unix-timestamp deadline for accepting the authenticated callback.

requirements.checkable: When an authenticated, ABI-decodable VRF callback arrives but cannot resolve the raffle (e.g. wrong status, expired deadline, mismatched requestId, or empty randomWords), it does not revert and instead emits VrfCallbackIgnored(receivedRequestId, expectedRequestId, status).
requirements.quote: Emitted when an authenticated, ABI-decodable callback cannot resolve the raffle.

requirements.checkable: When an authenticated VRF callback resolves the raffle, it selects a 1-based winningEntry in [1, totalEntries], sets status to NftWon or CashWon, and emits RaffleResolved(requestId, winningEntry, result).
requirements.quote: @param winningEntry Selected one-based global entry number in `[1,totalEntries]`.

requirements.checkable: Transitioning to Status.Refunding emits RefundsEnabled(finalizer, remainingRefundLiability) with the initial refund liability.
requirements.quote: Emitted when the raffle enters the full-refund branch.

requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket emits WinningTicketSettled(ticketId, settler, result, cashAmount, protocolFee, sponsorAmount) with cashAmount == 0 when result is NftWon, protocolFee rounded down from gross sales, and sponsorAmount equal to the remaining pot after cashAmount and protocolFee.

redeemWinningTicket emits WinningTicketRedeemed(ticketId, winner, result, cashAmount, prizeToken, prizeTokenId) where cashAmount is 0 for NftWon, and prizeToken is address(0) and prizeTokenId is 0 for CashWon.
refundTickets refunds amount == entryQuantity * ENTRY_PRICE and emits TicketsRefunded(owner, ticketQuantity, entryQuantity, amount, remainingRefundLiability).
requirements.quote:
@param amount Raw six-decimal quote-token units refunded, equal to `entryQuantity * ENTRY_PRICE`.
    /// @param remainingRefundLiability Raw six-decimal quote-token units still claimable after this refund.

requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorProceeds emits SponsorProceedsReleased(caller, recipient, amount) when releasing the sponsor balance to sponsorRecipient.
requirements.quote: Emitted when the complete current sponsor balance is released to its immutable recipient.

requirements.checkable: releaseProtocolFees emits ProtocolFeesReleased(caller, treasury, amount) when releasing the protocol-fee balance to protocolTreasury.
requirements.quote: Emitted when the complete current protocol-fee balance is released to the immutable treasury.

requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorPrize emits SponsorPrizeReleased(caller, recipient, prizeToken, prizeTokenId) when returning the escrowed prize to sponsorRecipient.
requirements.quote: Emitted when the escrowed prize is returned after a cash result or refund transition.

requirements.checkable: initialize reverts with OnlyFactory() if msg.sender != factory.
requirements.quote: Raised when a caller other than the immutable factory attempts clone initialization.

requirements.checkable: initialize reverts with AlreadyInitialized() if called more than once on a clone or if called on the locked implementation contract.
requirements.quote: Raised when initialization is attempted more than once or on the locked implementation.

requirements.checkable: Reverts with ZeroAddress() when a required address parameter is address(0).
requirements.quote: Raised when a required address is the zero address.

requirements.checkable: State-restricted operations revert with InvalidStatus(status) when invoked in a lifecycle status where they are unavailable.
requirements.quote: Raised when an operation is unavailable in the current lifecycle state.

requirements.checkable: onERC721Received reverts with UnexpectedPrize(token, tokenId, from, operator) if the callback does not come from prizeToken for prizeTokenId from sponsor operated by factory while in AwaitingPrize.
requirements.quote: Raised when an ERC-721 receiver callback does not exactly match the configured factory prize deposit.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries reverts with SaleEnded(endTime, block.timestamp) when block.timestamp >= endTime.
requirements.quote: Raised when an entry purchase is submitted at or after the exclusive sale end.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries reverts with InvalidRecipient() when recipient == address(0).
requirements.quote: Raised when an entry ticket would be minted to the zero address.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries reverts with ZeroEntryCount() when entryCount == 0.
requirements.quote: Raised when a purchase requests no entries.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries reverts with TotalEntriesOverflow(totalEntries, entryCount) when totalEntries + entryCount overflows uint128.
requirements.quote: Raised when a purchase would exceed the `uint128` global entry-number representation.

requirements.checkable: refundTickets reverts with InvalidTicketBatchSize(ticketIds.length, 100) when ticketIds.length == 0 or ticketIds.length > 100.
requirements.quote: Raised when a refund batch is empty or exceeds the bounded ticket limit.

requirements.checkable: Quote-token claims revert with InvalidQuoteDestination(destination) when the payout recipient is a rejected protocol destination.
requirements.quote: Raised when a quote-token claim targets a known protocol destination that could strand the claim.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw reverts with RaffleNotEnded(endTime, block.timestamp) when block.timestamp < endTime.
requirements.quote: Raised when a draw request is submitted before the sale end.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw reverts with DrawRequestWindowExpired(deadline, block.timestamp) when block.timestamp >= drawRequestDeadline().
requirements.quote: Raised when a draw request is submitted at or after the exclusive request deadline.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw reverts with NoEntriesSold() when totalEntries == 0.
requirements.quote: Raised when draw initiation is attempted for a raffle with zero sold entries.

requirements.checkable: enableRefunds reverts with RefundsNotAvailable(deadline, block.timestamp) when called before the applicable refund eligibility deadline.
requirements.quote: Raised when refunds are requested before the applicable liveness deadline.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw reverts with InsufficientVrfFee(requiredFee, msg.value) when msg.value is less than the quoted or actual Chainlink VRF wrapper fee.
requirements.quote: Raised when supplied native value cannot cover the quoted or actual Chainlink request fee.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw reverts with NativeRefundFailed(msg.sender, excess) if refunding excess native value to msg.sender fails.
requirements.quote: Raised when excess native value cannot be returned to the draw requester.

requirements.checkable: Reverts with NoWinnerProceeds() when attempting to claim cash-winner proceeds if none remain claimable.
requirements.quote: Raised when no current cash-winner proceeds remain claimable.

requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorProceeds reverts with NoSponsorProceeds() when sponsorProceeds == 0.
requirements.quote: Raised when no current sponsor proceeds remain claimable.

requirements.checkable: releaseProtocolFees reverts with NoProtocolFees() when protocolFees == 0.
requirements.quote: Raised when no current protocol fees remain claimable.

requirements.checkable: Initialization or ticket mint/transfer reverts with UnsafeProtocolDestination(destination) when targeting known protocol plumbing addresses.
requirements.quote: Raised when initialization or a ticket transfer targets known protocol plumbing.

requirements.checkable: Owner-only ticket operations (redeemWinningTicket, refundTickets) revert with NotTicketOwner(ticketId, msg.sender, owner) when msg.sender is not the current owner of ticketId.
requirements.quote: Raised when the caller is not the current owner of the supplied ticket.

requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket (and redeemWinningTicket when settling) reverts with TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry(ticketId, winningEntry) if ticketId's stored entry range [firstEntry, lastEntry] does not contain winningEntry.
requirements.quote: Raised when the supplied ticket range does not contain the selected winning entry.

requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket reverts with SettlementAlreadyComplete() if settlementComplete is already true.
requirements.quote: Raised when terminal liabilities have already been allocated.

requirements.checkable: redeemWinningTicket reverts with WinningTicketMismatch(ticketId, winningTicketId) if settlement is already complete and ticketId != winningTicketId.
requirements.quote: Raised when redemption supplies a ticket other than the recorded winning ticket.

requirements.checkable: redeemWinningTicket reverts with WinningTicketAlreadyRedeemed() if winnerRedeemed is already true.
requirements.quote: Raised when the winning ticket has already been burned and redeemed.

requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorPrize reverts with SponsorPrizeUnavailable(status) if status is neither CashWon nor Refunding.
requirements.quote: Raised when the sponsor prize cannot be returned in the current result state.

requirements.checkable: Prize release reverts with PrizeAlreadyClaimed() if prizeClaimed is already true.
requirements.quote: Raised when the escrowed prize has already been released.

requirements.checkable: After transferring the prize NFT, the contract checks prizeToken.ownerOf(prizeTokenId) == recipient and reverts with PrizeDeliveryVerificationFailed(recipient) if it does not match.
requirements.quote: Raised when the prize token does not report the expected owner after transfer.

requirements.checkable: initialize can only be called once per clone and only by factory, leaving the raffle waiting for prize escrow to activate it.
requirements.quote: Callable exactly once and only by the immutable canonical factory. Prize escrow activates the raffle later.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries accepts any entryCount > 0 (within uint128 totalEntries bounds) and mints one sequential ERC-721 ticket representing [firstEntry, lastEntry] to recipient.
requirements.quote: Buys any positive number of entries and mints one sequential ticket containing their inclusive range.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw pays the native Chainlink VRF wrapper fee and requests exactly 1 random word.
requirements.quote: Pays the current native Chainlink fee and requests the raffle's one random word.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw is permissionless (callable by any address).
requirements.quote: Callable by anyone only in `[endTime,drawRequestDeadline())` after at least one entry is sold.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw is only executable when block.timestamp >= endTime and block.timestamp < drawRequestDeadline().
requirements.quote: Callable by anyone only in `[endTime,drawRequestDeadline())` after at least one entry is sold.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw requires totalEntries >= 1.
requirements.quote: Callable by anyone only in `[endTime,drawRequestDeadline())` after at least one entry is sold.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw refunds any msg.value exceeding the actual VRF wrapper fee back to msg.sender within the same transaction.
requirements.quote: Any native value above the wrapper's actual fee is returned to the caller atomically.

requirements.checkable: When entries have been sold and no draw was requested, enableRefunds transitions the raffle from Active to Refunding at or after drawRequestDeadline().
requirements.quote: Enables full refunds after the sold-raffle request deadline or an accepted request's callback deadline.

requirements.checkable: When a draw was requested (status == Drawing), enableRefunds transitions the raffle to Refunding at or after callbackDeadline().
requirements.quote: Enables full refunds after the sold-raffle request deadline or an accepted request's callback deadline.

requirements.checkable: When totalEntries == 0 and status == Active, sponsor can call enableRefunds immediately (even before endTime) to transition to Refunding.
requirements.quote: Also closes an empty raffle immediately for the sponsor and after sale end for anyone.

requirements.checkable: When totalEntries == 0 and status == Active, any caller can call enableRefunds at or after endTime to transition to Refunding.
requirements.quote: Also closes an empty raffle immediately for the sponsor and after sale end for anyone.

requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket verifies that ticketId's stored inclusive range [firstEntry, lastEntry] contains winningEntry and allocates winner, sponsor, and protocol liabilities.
settleWinningTicket is callable by anyone, does not read ownerOf(ticketId), leaves ticketId unburned/transferable, and performs no external token or NFT transfers.
requirements.quote: Anyone may execute; ownership is not read, the ticket remains transferable, and no external asset transfer occurs.

requirements.checkable: During settlement, the cash-winner allocation is rounded down, and sponsorProceeds is assigned the exact remainder of unsettledPot after subtracting winnerProceeds and protocolFees.
redeemWinningTicket requires the caller to be the current owner of the winning ticket, burns the ticket, and transfers the prize NFT (if NftWon) or cash proceeds (if CashWon) to the caller.
requirements.quote: Lets the current winning-ticket owner atomically burn the ticket and receive the NFT or cash prize.

requirements.checkable: If settlementComplete is false when redeemWinningTicket(ticketId) is called, redeemWinningTicket first executes winning-ticket settlement for ticketId in the same transaction.
requirements.quote: If necessary, this first settles the supplied winning ticket so the owner can complete both steps in one transaction.

requirements.checkable: If prize NFT or quote-token delivery fails during redeemWinningTicket, the transaction reverts so the ticket burn and all redemption state changes are rolled back.
requirements.quote: Any failed delivery reverts the burn and every redemption state change.

requirements.checkable: refundTickets requires 1 <= ticketIds.length <= 100.
requirements.quote: Accepts one to 100 tickets.

requirements.checkable: refundTickets reverts the entire transaction if any element in ticketIds is a duplicate (already burned in the loop), nonexistent (unminted or previously burned), or not owned by msg.sender.
requirements.quote: Duplicate, nonexistent, or foreign-owned IDs revert the entire batch.

requirements.checkable: refundTickets burns all supplied tickets and transfers amount == sum(entries) * ENTRY_PRICE in quoteToken to msg.sender.
releaseSponsorProceeds transfers the entire current sponsorProceeds balance to sponsorRecipient and zeroes sponsorProceeds.
requirements.quote: Releases the complete current sponsor-proceeds balance to the immutable sponsor recipient.

requirements.checkable: releaseProtocolFees transfers the entire current protocolFees balance to protocolTreasury and zeroes protocolFees.
requirements.quote: Releases the complete current protocol-fee balance to the immutable treasury.

requirements.checkable: releaseSponsorPrize transfers prizeTokenId of prizeToken back to sponsorRecipient when status is CashWon or Refunding.
requirements.quote: Returns the escrowed prize to the immutable sponsor recipient after `CashWon` or `Refunding`.

requirements.checkable: getVrfRequestPrice queries and returns vrfWrapper.calculateRequestPriceNative(callbackGasLimit, 1).
requirements.quote: Returns the wrapper's current native direct-funding price for the configured callback.

requirements.checkable: estimateVrfRequestPrice(requestGasPriceWei) queries and returns vrfWrapper.estimateRequestPriceNative(callbackGasLimit, 1, requestGasPriceWei).
ticketRange(ticketId) returns (0, 0) for any ticketId that has never been minted (ticketId == 0 or ticketId > ticketCount).
requirements.quote: Returns zeros for an ID that has never been minted; ranges remain historical after ticket burns.

requirements.checkable: Burning a ticket during redemption or refund does not delete its stored entry range; ticketRange(ticketId) still returns its historical (firstEntry, lastEntry).
requirements.quote: Returns zeros for an ID that has never been minted; ranges remain historical after ticket burns.

requirements.checkable: drawRequestDeadline() returns endTime + 2 days.
requirements.quote:
Returns the exclusive deadline for initiating the draw.
    /// @return deadline Unix timestamp, in seconds, equal to `endTime + 2 days`.

requirements.checkable: callbackDeadline() returns 0 when drawRequestedAt == 0, and returns drawRequestedAt + 2 days once a draw request has been recorded.
requirements.quote:
Returns the exclusive deadline for accepting the authenticated callback.
    /// @return deadline Unix timestamp, in seconds, equal to `drawRequestedAt + 2 days`, or zero before a request.

requirements.checkable: accountedQuoteBalance() returns unsettledPot + remainingRefundLiability + winnerProceeds + sponsorProceeds + protocolFees.
requirements.quote:
Returns all currently outstanding quote-token liabilities tracked by the raffle.
    /// @return amount Raw six-decimal quote-token units across the unsettled pot, refunds, and allocated claims.

requirements.checkable: grossSales() computes and returns uint256(totalEntries) * ENTRY_PRICE on the fly without storing a separate grossSales state variable.
ENTRY_PRICE() returns 1_000_000 (1e6).
requirements.quote:
Returns the fixed raw six-decimal quote-token price of one entry.
    /// @return price One entry price, exactly 1,000,000 raw units.

requirements.checkable: totalEntries() returns the cumulative count of entries sold across all tickets, which equals the last assigned global entry number.
requirements.quote:
Returns the lifetime global number of entries sold.
    /// @return entries Sold-entry count; also the last assigned global entry number.

requirements.checkable: ticketCount() returns the lifetime number of range tickets minted, which equals the latest assigned ticket ID.
requirements.quote:
Returns the lifetime number of range tickets minted.
    /// @return tickets Ticket count; also the latest assigned ticket ID.

requirements.checkable: unsettledPot() returns the unallocated quote-token sale pot collected before settlement or refund activation (and becomes 0 once settled or refunding is enabled).
requirements.quote:
Returns the current unallocated sale pot.
    /// @return amount Raw six-decimal quote-token units collected before settlement or refund activation.

requirements.checkable: winnerRecipient() returns address(0) before redeemWinningTicket succeeds, and returns the redeeming ticket owner's address afterward.
requirements.quote:
Returns the address that burned and redeemed the winning ticket.
    /// @return recipient Winner at redemption time, or the zero address before redemption.

requirements.checkable: vrfRequestId(), drawRequestedAt(), resolvedAt(), winningEntry(), and winningTicketId() return 0 prior to their respective lifecycle milestones (request persistence, resolution, settlement).
settlementComplete(), winnerRedeemed(), and prizeClaimed() return false initially and transition to true upon winning-ticket settlement, winning-ticket redemption, and prize NFT release respectively.
initialized() is true on the deployed implementation contract (locked in constructor) and becomes true on each clone upon initialize().
requirements.quote:
Returns whether this implementation or clone has completed its one-time initialization step.
    /// @return complete True for the locked implementation and every initialized clone.
